thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - GPU_CAPACITY_STARVATION (sev=P0) in eu-west-1. Autoscaler reports repeated placement_failures and provider rate_limit on allocations. Queue length 18,600 and rising; observed 502s + 429s across multiple tenants. Pager: sam-oncall

sam-oncall: ack. pulling up the live dashboard and recent deploy events. Any known rollouts in the last hour?

anya-sre: seeing a flurry of errors: autoscaler tried to create new instances but received 429/provider_rate_limit and later placement_failed: "constraints_unsatisfiable: memory_affinity". Also noticed pool reported max_provisioning_inflight=12 which is hitting our internal safety cap.

dmitri-ml: we pushed answer-lite-v5 to eu-west-highmem at 2026-06-01T05:10Z which includes larger KV caches and pins ~30GB GPU memory per replica. That plus a concurrent batch run will hurt packing.

mei-ops: confirmed a heavy nightly embedding job (big-embed-900) started at 05:05Z and targeted any highmem pool. I can pause it; want me to?

oliver-support: CS seeing a surge of customer errors: C-5120, C-5188, C-5244 reporting request failures and rate-limited responses. They want an ETA and clear mitigation steps to share.

sam-oncall: pause big-embed-900, please. Also enable emergency warm-pool spin-up for enterprise routes (we have a cold reserve configured). I'll attempt to bump pool inflight cap to allow more concurrent provisioning if provider will accept.

mei-ops: pausing big-embed-900 now: `jobsctl pause big-embed-900 --reason "incident: free highmem capacity"` paused at 05:15:42Z. That should free ~6 node-equivalents.

infra-bot: Warm pool activation requested by sam-oncall at 2026-06-01T05:16:03Z: warm_pool(eu-west-highmem) -> spin_up 4 reserved nodes (enterprise-reserve).

anya-sre: autoscaler log snippet:```
[2026-06-01T05:14:58Z] autoscaler: scale_up(pool=eu-west-highmem) attempt=1 -> ProviderAPIError: rate_limit_exceeded (code=429)
[2026-06-01T05:15:20Z] autoscaler: attempt=2 -> PlacementError: constraints_unsatisfiable (memory_affinity: required=30GB, available_bins=0)
[2026-06-01T05:15:50Z] autoscaler: failed_all_attempts -> marking pool degraded; enqueue_length 18600
```
Sounds like two simultaneous issues: provider-side throttling and our placement rules now incompatible with current model density.

dmitri-ml: immediate mitigation: we can flip a dynamic packing override to allow looser affinity for the highmem pool temporarily (risk: slight variance in latency); or fallback traffic to answer-lite-v3 which uses smaller caches. I can flip fallback in 90s.

sam-oncall: do both: enable fallback for non-enterprise traffic and apply a packing override for 15m to allow autoscaler to bin-pack more aggressively. Mei, can you authorize pack override?

mei-ops: authorizing temporary packing override: `redwoodctl pool update eu-west-highmem --packing-override aggressive --ttl 15m --by incident` applied at 05:17:12Z.

dmitri-ml: applying fallback route change: `redwoodctl routing set --route eu-west/highmem --fallback answer-lite-v3 --selector tier!=enterprise` done at 05:17:40Z.

infra-bot: Warm pool nodes booting: 2/4 ready at 05:19Z, full warm pool ready at 05:21Z.

anya-sre: after packing override and warm nodes we see queue fall: 18.6k -> 9.4k in 3m. 429 spike rate down by 60%. Autoscaler reports reduced placement errors but still seeing provider_rate_limit on subsequent scale requests.

oliver-support: customers C-5120 and C-5188 reporting fewer errors after 05:20Z. I'm updating the tickets: interim mitigation applied, no data loss, working on full recovery.

sam-oncall: we should also enable cross-region failover for enterprise traffic in case provider doesn't supply additional capacity. Nisha, can product sign off on cross-region for enterprise?

nisha-product: cross-region failover OK for enterprise accounts as a mitigation; we'll coordinate CS messaging about failover and potential latency changes. Approve.

mei-ops: enabling enterprise failover: `redwoodctl routing update --route eu-west/highmem --failover-regions eu-central,us-east-1 --selector tier=enterprise` applied at 05:22:10Z.

anya-sre: provider support ticket #PR-84290 created and escalated due to rate-limited allocations. Provider preliminary: "we're experiencing control-plane rate throttling impacting large allocation bursts; ETA unknown." They've acknowledged warm pool reservations but cannot guarantee more immediate ephemeral capacity.

dmitri-ml: quality note: answer-lite-v3 has minor latency and quality delta versus v5; acceptable for non-enterprise traffic short-term. I'll monitor evaluation signals and set a regression alert.

sam-oncall: summary of actions so far: pause heavy batch (big-embed-900), pack-override (15m), warm-pool spin-up (4 nodes), fallback non-enterprise to v3, enterprise multi-region failover. Queue down to 2.4k by 05:27Z. Still watching provider ticket.

oliver-support: CS blurb drafted: "We experienced a temporary GPU capacity shortage in eu-west-1 that caused elevated error rates for some customers. We've paused heavy background jobs, enabled fallbacks, spun up reserved warm nodes, and enabled cross-region failover for enterprise traffic; traffic is recovering. We'll follow up with a postmortem and timeline. Impacted: C-5120, C-5188, C-5244. No data loss."

anya-sre: adding immediate follow-ups to incident board: [SRE-A] add provider_rate_limit to pager rules and circuit-break autoscaler on repeated 429; [SRE-B] implement packing-sanity check in deploy pipeline; [INFRA] maintain a small warm reserve for highmem pools; [ML] density review for answer-lite-v5 and recommend memory caps.

dmitri-ml: I'll own ML item: produce density and cache-impact report and propose a memory cap or staged rollout gating. Target: draft in 24h.

mei-ops: ops followups: create policy to prevent large embedding jobs targeting highmem pools unless explicitly flagged, set warm-pool minimum 2 nodes for eu-west-highmem. Filing ticket OPS-88.

nisha-product: I'll coordinate customer comms and check top impacted accounts for outreach. Also decide whether to offer credits if SLA threshold crossed.

infra-bot: Incident 2805432190 recorded with mitigations: batch_paused, packing_override, warm_pool_activated, fallback_applied, enterprise_failover_enabled.

sam-oncall: handing follow-up to anya-sre for postmortem and provider escalation. I'll be available for 1h then sign off. Please keep this thread updated with provider ETA and any rollback of packing_override.

anya-sre: taking lead for post-incident. I'll gather autoscaler traces, warm-pool timeline, deploy diffs and the provider ticket. Tentative labels: [cause: model_density + provider_rate_limit + placement_policy]. Will schedule postmortem meeting.

sam-oncall: thanks team. ending active triage. :white_check_mark:
